easy: A machine you use to talk to someone who is far away.

ex.en: My mom talked to Grandma on the phone.

easy: Paintings, drawings, and other things people make to look at and enjoy.

ex.en: We saw beautiful art at the museum.
ex.ko: 우리는 박물관에서 아름다운 미술 작품을 보았다.

easy: Making beautiful things, like paintings or music.

ex.en: Making art makes me feel happy and calm.
ex.ko: 예술 활동을 하면 나는 행복하고 마음이 편안해진다.

easy: A skill that you get better at by learning and practicing.

ex.en: Cooking is an art that takes years of practice.

easy: In the back of someone or something.

ex.en: My little brother ran behind me.

easy: Still in a place after other people or things have gone.

ex.en: I left my lunch box behind at home.

easy: A place with walls and a roof, like a school or an office.

ex.en: Our school is a very big building.

easy: The work of making houses, bridges, and other big things.

ex.en: The building of the new bridge took two years.

easy: Not hard to do.

ex.en: The math test was easy.

easy: Slow and relaxed, not rushed.

ex.en: We took an easy walk by the lake.

easy: Not far away.

ex.en: My school is near my house.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 우리 집 가까이에 있다.

easy: A list of steps you will follow to get something done.

ex.en: Our plan is to build a snowman after school.
ex.ko: 우리 계획은 방과 후에 눈사람을 만드는 것이다.

easy: A drawing that shows how to make a house or other big thing.

ex.en: Dad looked at the plan for our new house.
ex.ko: 아빠는 우리 새 집의 설계도를 살펴보셨다.

easy: Having to do with the people who run a country or a town.

ex.en: The mayor gave a political speech.

easy: A fairly big amount; more than a little.

ex.en: The soup was quite hot.

easy: All the way; completely.

ex.en: You are quite right about that.
ex.ko: 그것에 대해서는 네 말이 완전히 맞아.

easy: The number that comes after five.

ex.en: I have six pencils in my bag.
ex.ko: 나는 가방에 연필이 여섯 자루 있다.

easy: One more than five.

ex.en: We have six eggs in the basket.

easy: Saying things back and forth with other people.

ex.en: Talking with my best friend always makes me feel better.
ex.ko: 가장 친한 친구와 이야기를 나누면 늘 기분이 나아진다.

easy: As someone says or writes.

ex.en: According to my teacher, the test is on Friday.

easy: Ready for you to get or use.

ex.en: Is that library book available?
ex.ko: 그 도서관 책을 빌릴 수 있나요?

easy: Free and not busy.

ex.en: Mr. Kim is available to talk after class.
ex.ko: 김 선생님은 수업 후에 이야기할 시간이 되신다.

easy: Teaching and learning, usually at school.

ex.en: Good education helps children learn to read and write.
ex.ko: 좋은 교육은 아이들이 읽고 쓰는 법을 배우도록 도와준다.

easy: What you know because you went to school and learned.

ex.en: She has a good education and speaks three languages.
ex.ko: 그녀는 좋은 교육을 받아서 세 가지 언어를 말한다.

easy: Coming at the very end.

ex.en: We played the final game of the season.
ex.ko: 우리는 이번 시즌의 마지막 경기를 했다.

easy: Not able to be changed.

ex.en: The teacher's decision is final.

easy: From an earlier time, but not now.

ex.en: My former teacher came to visit our class.
ex.ko: 예전 선생님이 우리 반에 놀러 오셨다.

easy: To say or write things one after another.

ex.en: Please list your three favorite animals.
ex.ko: 가장 좋아하는 동물 세 가지를 나열해 보세요.

easy: To put something on a list.

ex.en: My name is listed on the class chart.
ex.ko: 내 이름은 반 명단에 올라 있다.

easy: To tip over to one side.

ex.en: The old ship began to list in the storm.
ex.ko: 낡은 배가 폭풍 속에서 한쪽으로 기울기 시작했다.

easy: All set and able to start.

ex.en: Are you ready for the spelling test?
ex.ko: 너는 받아쓰기 시험 볼 준비가 됐니?

easy: Not always, but some of the time.

ex.en: Sometimes my dog sleeps on my bed.
ex.ko: 가끔 우리 강아지는 내 침대에서 잔다.

easy: A boy who is the child of a mother and father.

ex.en: Their son plays soccer after school.
ex.ko: 그들의 아들은 방과 후에 축구를 한다.

easy: A road in a town with houses or shops along it.

ex.en: We walked down the street to the park.
ex.ko: 우리는 길을 따라 걸어서 공원에 갔다.

easy: The part of the road where cars drive.

ex.en: Look both ways before you cross the street.

easy: To carry something or someone with you to a place.

ex.en: Please bring your lunch to school.

easy: A school you go to after high school.

ex.en: My sister will go to college next year.

easy: One thing that shows what a whole group is like.

ex.en: A dog is an example of a pet.

easy: A person or thing that is good to copy.

ex.en: My big sister is a good example for me.

easy: To live through something hard.

ex.en: Our town experienced a very big snowstorm.
ex.ko: 우리 마을은 아주 큰 눈보라를 겪었다.

easy: To feel or live through something yourself.

ex.en: I want to experience riding a roller coaster.
ex.ko: 나는 롤러코스터를 타 보는 경험을 해 보고 싶다.

easy: To see someone and talk with them.

ex.en: I met my friend at the park.

easy: To come together with other people for a reason.

ex.en: Our soccer team meets every Saturday.

easy: To come together at one place.

ex.en: The two rivers meet near our town.
ex.ko: 두 강은 우리 마을 근처에서 만난다.

easy: A show on TV or radio.

ex.en: My favorite TV program is on at six.
ex.ko: 내가 제일 좋아하는 TV 프로그램은 여섯 시에 한다.

easy: A group of things that are alike.

ex.en: What type of ice cream do you like?

easy: A very young child who cannot walk or talk yet.

ex.en: The baby smiled at me.

easy: The youngest one in a family or group.

ex.en: I am the baby of my family.

easy: A time when you are able to do something good.

ex.en: I got a chance to play goalie.

easy: Things that happen by luck, with no plan.

ex.en: We met by chance at the store.

easy: A man who has a child.

ex.en: My father makes pancakes on Sundays.

easy: To walk in a line with others, like in a parade.

ex.en: The band marched down the street.

easy: To walk fast with big, steady steps.

ex.en: Mia marched into the kitchen and asked for a snack.
ex.ko: 미아는 성큼성큼 부엌으로 들어가 간식을 달라고 했다.

easy: Words and music that you sing.

ex.en: We sang a funny song on the bus.

easy: Reading and thinking hard so you can learn something.

ex.en: Study time begins after dinner.
ex.ko: 공부 시간은 저녁 식사 후에 시작된다.

easy: A group of letters that has a meaning.

ex.en: I learned a new word today.

easy: A short thing that someone says.

ex.en: He did not say a word.

easy: Something that a person does.

ex.en: Helping a lost puppy was a kind action.
ex.ko: 길 잃은 강아지를 도와준 것은 친절한 행동이었다.

easy: To take away things that are in the way.

ex.en: Please clear your desk before lunch.

easy: To move things away so people can walk through.

ex.en: We cleared a path through the snow.

easy: To become bright, with no clouds.

ex.en: The sky cleared and we went outside to play.
ex.ko: 하늘이 개어서 우리는 밖에 나가 놀았다.

easy: One of the 12 parts of a year, like May or June.

ex.en: My birthday is in the month of October.

easy: About 30 days.

ex.en: It took a month for the bean plant to grow.
ex.ko: 콩 식물이 자라는 데 한 달이 걸렸다.

easy: On the part that is not inside.

ex.en: Please paint the outside wall of the doghouse.
ex.ko: 개집 바깥쪽 벽에 페인트를 칠해 주세요.

easy: Coming from somewhere else, not from inside.

ex.en: Outside noise woke me up.

easy: You, as your own special person.

ex.en: Be your true self with your friends.
ex.ko: 친구들 앞에서는 있는 그대로의 네 자신이 되어라.

easy: What someone says out loud.

ex.en: I listened to my teacher's kind words.
ex.ko: 나는 선생님의 다정한 말씀을 귀 기울여 들었다.

easy: The words of a song.

ex.en: I know all the words to that song.
ex.ko: 나는 그 노래의 가사를 다 안다.

easy: A long, flat piece of wood.

ex.en: Dad nailed a board over the hole in the fence.
ex.ko: 아빠는 울타리 구멍에 판자를 못으로 박으셨다.

easy: A flat piece of wood or other material used for a special job.

ex.en: We played the game on a big board.
ex.ko: 우리는 큰 판 위에서 게임을 했다.

easy: To divide something with a knife or scissors.

ex.en: Please cut the paper with scissors.

easy: To make something smaller or less.

ex.en: We cut our screen time to one hour.
ex.ko: 우리는 화면 보는 시간을 한 시간으로 줄였다.

easy: To turn quickly to one side.

ex.en: The bike cut left to miss the puddle.
ex.ko: 자전거가 웅덩이를 피하려고 왼쪽으로 급히 꺾었다.

easy: A big, open piece of land with grass or crops.

ex.en: The cows were eating grass in the field.

easy: A place outside a lab or office where people do real work or study things.

ex.en: Scientists study birds in the field.

easy: In place of something else.

ex.en: We had no milk, so I drank juice instead.
ex.ko: 우유가 없어서 나는 대신 주스를 마셨다.

easy: The most important.

ex.en: The main road goes to our school.

easy: A very short time, or one exact time.

ex.en: At that moment, the lights went out.

easy: A woman who has a child.

ex.en: My mother reads me a story at night.
ex.ko: 엄마는 밤에 나에게 이야기를 읽어 주신다.

easy: A wide path for cars and trucks.

ex.en: Our bus drove down a long road.

easy: The way you follow to get something you want.

ex.en: Practice is the road to getting better.

easy: A place where people live that is bigger than a village but smaller than a city.

ex.en: We drove into town to buy ice cream.
ex.ko: 우리는 아이스크림을 사러 시내에 차를 타고 갔다.

easy: All the people who live in a small city or village.

ex.en: The whole town cheered for the team.
ex.ko: 온 마을 사람들이 그 팀을 응원했다.

easy: One part of a big store or company.

ex.en: The toy department is on the second floor.

easy: When two people yell at each other or try to hurt each other.

ex.en: My brother and I had a fight over the toy.

easy: A strong wish to win.

ex.en: Our team showed a lot of fight in the last game.
ex.ko: 우리 팀은 마지막 경기에서 대단한 투지를 보였다.

easy: Good enough; okay.

ex.en: My cold is gone and I feel fine.

easy: Very thin or very small.

ex.en: She has fine, soft hair.
ex.ko: 그녀는 가늘고 부드러운 머리카락을 가지고 있다.

easy: To notice sounds with your ears.

ex.en: I can hear birds singing outside.

easy: To find out about something.

ex.en: I heard that we have a new classmate.
ex.ko: 나는 새 친구가 전학 온다는 말을 들었다.

easy: A big problem or question that people talk about and disagree on.

ex.en: Pollution is an important issue.

easy: One copy of a magazine from a certain week or month.

ex.en: I read the new issue of my science magazine.
ex.ko: 나는 과학 잡지의 새 호를 읽었다.

easy: To stay still and not move.

ex.en: The cat rests on the warm rug.
ex.ko: 고양이가 따뜻한 깔개 위에서 쉬고 있다.

easy: To stop and relax for a short time.

ex.en: Let's rest under the tree after the hike.

easy: To let a part of your body relax so it can get better.

ex.en: I rested my sore foot after the game.
ex.ko: 나는 경기 후에 아픈 발을 쉬게 했다.

easy: Moving along, like water in a stream or from a tap.

ex.en: We washed our hands in running water.

easy: The huge, endless place that holds everything, like Earth and the stars.

ex.en: Stars and planets float in space.

easy: An empty place between things.

ex.en: Is there any space for my backpack?

easy: A place kept for a special use.

ex.en: There is a parking space behind the school.

easy: The hottest time of the year, after spring.

ex.en: We swim at the beach every summer.

easy: A woman who is married to a man.

ex.en: My uncle and his wife came to dinner.
ex.ko: 삼촌과 삼촌의 아내가 저녁을 먹으러 오셨다.

easy: Very nice to look at or listen to.

ex.en: The garden is full of beautiful flowers.

easy: Very nice and sunny, great for being outside.

ex.en: What a beautiful day for a picnic!

easy: The number of the day in a month.

ex.en: What is today's date?

easy: A time you plan ahead to meet someone.

ex.en: I have a play date with Ben on Saturday.
ex.ko: 나는 토요일에 벤과 놀기로 약속이 있다.

easy: A piece of ground that someone owns.

ex.en: Grandpa bought some land for a farm.

easy: The top layer of earth where plants grow.

ex.en: The land by the river is good for growing corn.

easy: To not hear or see something.

ex.en: I missed what the teacher said.

easy: To feel sad because someone is not with you.

ex.en: I miss my grandma in Korea.

easy: To not go to something you planned to go to.

ex.en: I missed my friend's party because I was sick.
ex.ko: 나는 아파서 친구의 생일 파티에 가지 못했다.

easy: To reach out past the edge of something.

ex.en: A nail projected from the board.

easy: A hit or kick of a ball in a game.

ex.en: Her shot went right into the net.
ex.ko: 그녀의 슛이 곧바로 골망 안으로 들어갔다.
